query:
SELECT g.id as org_id, g.name as org_name, sd.id as dept_id, sd.name as dept_name, sd.organizationId 
FROM groups g 
LEFT JOIN staffDepartments sd ON g.id = sd.organizationId 
WHERE g.name LIKE '%Joburg%';
